Results.ReviewText: J'ai fait l'achat de ce barbecue pour avoir la possibilité d'alterner entre la plancha et le barbecue. Une fois l'achat fait, je remarque que la planche vendu pour ce modèle est trop grand. Suite à mes recherches le même modèle Spirit a changé de dimension avec les années, mais pas la planche qui va dessus. Les alternatives maintenant offerte ne me conviennent pas du tout.
Results.Title: Déception totale

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago and am enjoying bbqs.....
Results.Title: Big features in smaller footprint bbq

Results.ReviewText: The flame ignition is awkward and is the worst design! If I had realized how it was designed I never would have purchased it!!
Results.Title: Awkward design of ignition system!

Results.ReviewText: Indirect heat option is amazing and the deep deep bowl definitely helps avoiding flare ups.
Results.Title: It’s great and motivating to grill

Results.ReviewText: Prior to this grill we had the Spirit E-310 grill. It was a great grill that lasted over 15 years. It was time to get a replacement because the output was getting slower and we needed to replace our grates. When I went to Home Depot I saw the Spirit E-325. It was all we wanted in a new grill. The size was perfect and it came with updated features like a sear zone. I recommend this grill for those with small families.
Results.Title: This grill fits our needs

Results.ReviewText: I bought an E325 in June that had to be replaced due to ignitors stopped work. The cook temperature on that grill was fantastic approaching 800 degrees with Boosts on. The replacement grill I received will only reach about 670 degrees. This is very disappointing.
Results.Title: Spirit E325

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill but wish it was easier to move around.
Results.Title: Lacking mobility

Results.ReviewText: After working out some issues that happened with transportation the product is great.
Results.Title: Great grilling

Results.ReviewText: works well, cooks evenly, nice and easy to use, easy clean up with grill
Results.Title: Good review of an excellent Weber Product

Results.ReviewText:
Had a two burner model. Didn’t like how it made steaks. The searing option on the 325 works great!  Also, this model has pizo-electric starters on each burner. The two burner model had a battery powered igniter that was shared and it was finicky about lighting the left burner. 

Only change I would make is to add swiveling wheels on the front legs. The ones that can be locked. I keep the grill in my garage and have to roll it out to use it. This winter that could get tricky when we have ice.
Results.Title: Works great!

Results.ReviewText: Now that we’re approaching the end of summer, I’ve would like to say that I bought my E325 at the end of May and it is still having lid popping issues. Customer service isn’t doing anything. They’re not even emailing me back anymore. I kept telling customer service that it’s the aluminum piece that’s on the inside of the hood, but nobody listens. It’s scratched up the back of my grill and Now there’s no more protective coding on the cook box.  They (Weber) thought they were gonna solve the problem by giving me some replacement parts. So I waited a month to get the part, because they messed up on the shipping, and open the box and there was clevis pins. How is that gonna fix the issue when I specifically told them that it was the aluminum piece on the inside back of the hood?I don’t know what happened to Weber’s quality and customer service really lacking. I even had a Weber social and review specialist contact me, and that didn’t even do any good. I wouldn’t buy another Webber product unless it was a kettle grill or maybe you have to spend the money to get a Genesis before they listen to your problems.I’ve had issues with it since day one and I don’t recommend wasting you’re money on this grill.
Results.Title: Terrible grill don’t waste you’re $500

Results.ReviewText: Good mid range bbq. 3 burner with "sear feature". Works well, temp holding is good. Not my Genesis gold of 23 years, but does the job. We scaled down is size for this one.
Results.Title: Giid performance

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill Stealth® Edition (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText: Get grill. Came highly recommended and has lived up to the recommendations. Easy to use, excellent results! Looking forward to years of tasty results.
Results.Title: Lived up to it’s reputation

Results.ReviewText: Works like I expected to work. Only wish I vould turn the burners to lower heat for slow cooking.
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product. Easy to start and cooks like nothing I’ve ever used in the past.
Results.Title: My new grill

Results.ReviewText: Such a great grill with good price point.  This is my second purchase of the same grill. Does not disappoint.
Results.Title: Wonderful little grill

Results.ReviewText: Wish it had 4 wheels rather than just the 2. It would also be better if the wheels rotated for easier maneuverability. The propane tank makes it heavy and difficult to lift onto the wheels to turn the grill when moving it from the “storage” place.
Results.Title: Wish it had 4 wheels.

Results.ReviewText: Overpriced other than cistco layed in the year selling the better model with cover at the best price. $200 differences
Results.Title: As described!! For the model overpriced.

Results.ReviewText:
Happy with this. I don’t seem to have hot and cold spots. Gets nice and hot. Heat is very even and consistent. I can cook better food with this than with other BBQ’s. 

Cons:  wheels are small and plastic. Not great if you have to move it around much.
Results.Title: Even, consistent and predictable heat.

Results.ReviewText: Well built and provides even heat across the grill. Sear option is fantastic for quickly searing steaks. Also, this grill provides good cooking area for its size. Definitely recommend!
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: This is one of several Webers I have owned over the years from a kettle and 3 or 4 different gas grills. This one is a keeper!!
Results.Title: Excellent grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill. The temp is easy to control and is consistent throughout the cooking surface. The build quality is great. This grill is easy to clean and maintain. I highly recommend this grill, for the price it is excellent.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: This Weber replaced a 25 year old Weber. We love it! Weber is so dependable, there was no question what brand we were going to purchase to replace the one we bought in 2001! Yes, that’s 2001!
Results.Title: Love our Weber

Results.ReviewText: I love my new grill.  It's my third Weber and the only brand I'll ever buy.
Results.Title: Repeat Customer

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill Stealth® Edition (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Great grill! I came from a very old Genesis which was a hand me down. It was reliable like all Weber products. But it is just my wife and I now, so we decided to get something a little smaller. This has folding tables on both sides so the storage profile is minimal. I really like the “stealth” package! And the cooking system just works so well! Burgers, steaks, chicken wings all come out perfect. No flame gets to the grates, it maintains even temperature even when it’s breezy outside! Love it! Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: Another great Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Replacement to a previous Weber grill that we had for over 12+ years. We wanted to downsize and the Spirit E-325 fit the bill. The Spirit E-325 was easy to assemble and is also very easy to use. The grill is well made. Love the lighting of each burner via each individual control knob feature. The grill provides for ample cooking space and it heats up quickly. The fold down, side tables and the grill sear section are a nice addition. Lastly, the grill is attractive and looks great.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-325 Gas (propane) Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I have had Weber grills for decades! This one is really different. It appears Weber has decided to produce a product that has lower its standards of materials. The base is made less durable than my previous grills and the actual grill itself appears of lesser quality also. I am disappointed in the build of the grill and I paid about $600 which appeared beyond the quality. 
I am not sure I would buy another!!
Results.Title: Disappointed in Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill Stealth® Edition (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText:
This is the first Weber gas grill I've owned in over 30 years and boy did I miss you! 
I've gone through 3 grills that were not Webers and I learned my lesson!
Results.Title: It's a Weber or NOTHING!

Results.ReviewText: To date it has been great, however I need a little more experience with it!
Results.Title: It’s getting there …

Results.ReviewText: I have used this grill about 5 times since purchasing it and it works well.  My only complaint is the searing function doesn't appear to work as well during some uses,  i.e. the higher flame doesn't seem to.be working and it is impossible to view the flame intensity under the flavor bars,  so you can only tell when some of the steaks are not showing sear marks or holding your hand over the middle burner doesn't feel hot enough to sear.
Results.Title: Works very well most times

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill Stealth® Edition (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText: My Weber seems to work okay but I have noticed the smell of propane in the cabinet even after checking all customer accessable connections.
Results.Title: Seems to work okay

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to replace my older Spirit grill. I am happy that it works great and now has added sear zones. The build quality has gone down some compared to my older model. I really wish I had just kept and rebuilt the burner systems on my older grill. It,however,is a good grill and works as it should.
Results.Title: All around a good grill
